name: How do I know if my mobile home floor needs repair or full replacement?
description: Small, localized damage can often be repaired. Widespread soft spots, sagging, or rot usually mean the subfloor needs replacement instead of a simple patch.

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my mobile home floor needs repair or full replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: You usually need a repair rather than a full replacement if the damage is limited to a small area and the joists or framing are still sound. A full replacement is more likely when there is widespread rot, repeated water damage, or the subfloor has failed in several rooms.
